_meta.note: Test fixture for npc-story-events NR1.2 (the real file is narrative-seed's).

none.description: The slot has no gate beyond its kind's own.
none.negative: Not 'unknown': the slot has no gate beyond its kind's own.

danger-band-is.description: The room's danger band is a named band.
danger-band-is.negative: Not a difficulty scale; a named band, never a number.

disposition-is.description: The subject's relation band is at most a named band.
disposition-is.negative: Not a loyalty rank; disposition belongs to a creature that has not joined.

character-state-is.description: The subject was met, joined, left or fell.
character-state-is.negative: Not a relation band; it says whether the character was met, never how warm it is.

story-flag-set.description: A named story flag is set.
story-flag-set.negative: Not a counter; a flag is set or it is not.

lead-level-at-least.description: The summoner has reached a named level gate.
lead-level-at-least.negative: Not a level and not a band: a named gate whose threshold lives in tuning.

doctrine-studying.description: The host world's antagonist studies or holds a doctrine.
doctrine-studying.negative: Not a doctrine id and not a fight.

role-cast.description: A role declared by the same storylet was cast.
role-cast.negative: Not a leaf; casting decides it before eligibility is evaluated.
